notes_zh: 本轮修复：🖱️ 角落桌宠真的能点了（之前 pointer-events:none 把整个 stage 区压死了）· 🎙️ Whisper 默认从 Base → Small（中文识别准度大跳，bundled Base 做 fallback 兜底首装零网络体验）· 现有用户自动迁移 Base → Small
notes_en: This release fixes: 🖱️ Corner-anchored pet is finally clickable (previous CSS pointer-events:none silently killed all clicks across the entire stage) · 🎙️ Whisper default Base → Small for much better Chinese accuracy, with bundled Base as instant fallback while Small downloads · existing users on Base auto-migrate
